options_evaluated: Glass-fiber reinforced polyamide (PA6-GF30) with overmolded TPE grips
Recycled aluminum alloy shell with mechanical rubber grips
assessments.recommendation: Recycled aluminum alloy shell with mechanical rubber grips
assessments.rationale: An aluminum shell provides superior durability and reliability (a) [Page 79] against physical drops during operation, preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27]. Avoiding overmolded thermoplastic elastomers (TPE) prevents the release of microplastics and nanoplastics (p) [Page 80] due to friction and wear during in-service handling. Mechanical rubber grips can be individually replaced, supporting ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] and reducing waste generated by using the product (r) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing and Material Sourcing stages, as aluminum has a higher initial carbon footprint and energy consumption during extraction and processing compared to plastics.

options_evaluated: Threaded fasteners (torx screws) with brass inserts
assessments.recommendation: Threaded fasteners (torx screws) with brass inserts
assessments.rationale: Using threaded fasteners allows for non-destructive disassembly, directly supporting ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] and improving the repairability score based on ease of disassembly and tool availability [Page 8]. This enables professional repairers [Page 29] or users to replace internal components, preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] and significantly reducing the amounts of waste generated by using the product (r) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, as threaded assembly with brass inserts increases production time, complexity, and initial assembly costs compared to ultrasonic welding or adhesive bonding.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with digital controller
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with digital controller
assessments.rationale: A brushless motor eliminates mechanical brush wear, drastically increasing the technical lifetime, durability, and reliability (a) [Page 79] of the tool. It also optimizes the use or consumption of energy while in service (g) [Page 79], reducing the overall environmental footprint of using the product (m) [Page 79] and ensuring high functional performance (s) [Page 80] over its active service life.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Material Sourcing and Manufacturing stages, due to the use of critical raw materials (rare earth magnets in the rotor) and the high environmental footprint of manufacturing complex electronic controllers.

options_evaluated: Active cooling with integrated fan on motor shaft
Phase change materials (PCM) with sealed housing
assessments.recommendation: Active cooling with integrated fan on motor shaft
assessments.rationale: Active cooling prevents thermal stress on the motor and battery during intensive use, directly improving durability and reliability (a) [Page 79] and preventing premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] from overheating. Combining this with cleanable filters ensures ease of maintenance (b) [Page 79] and sustains optimal functional performance (s) [Page 80] under harsh operating conditions.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, due to increased part count, tighter tolerances, and assembly complexity. Also conflicts with End-of-Life stage due to more intricate disassembly of mixed materials.

options_evaluated: Modular architecture with separate plug-and-play modules (battery, trigger switch, motor/gearbox assembly)
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with separate plug-and-play modules (battery, trigger switch, motor/gearbox assembly)
assessments.rationale: A modular architecture ensures that individual faulty components can be easily swapped out, maximizing ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79]. It leverages the availability and accessibility of spare parts (l) [Page 79] and improves the repairability score [Page 8]. This prevents premature obsolescence (21) [Page 27] and minimizes the amounts of waste generated (r) [Page 80] during the operational lifetime.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design and Manufacturing stages, as modular connectors increase the overall physical volume, weight, and initial bill of materials cost of the screwdriver.

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack
assessments.rationale: A removable battery pack allows users to replace degraded batteries easily, directly addressing ease of repair and maintenance (b) [Page 79] and the availability of consumables and spare parts (l) [Page 79]. This prevents the entire tool from being discarded prematurely (21) [Page 27], reducing waste generated (r) [Page 80]. Standardized slide-on packs also ensure compatibility with other systems (s) [Page 80] and long-term spare part availability.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design stage (adds bulk and weight to the handle) and Manufacturing stage (requires robust mechanical latches, spring-loaded contacts, and additional safety circuitry).
